description: Make a link that invites people into one of the user's shared spaces, add a person to their contacts, or revoke an invite link this chat made. Fill in exactly ONE. Nothing is created or revoked until they approve it with `confirm`; a new link comes back for the user to send. One link works for the whole group (a trip, a home): everyone who opens it can join, until it expires or is revoked. A space has one live link at a time, so making a new one retires the old. A link made in Bluu or by another assistant is revoked in Bluu: Bluu answers with the way there. Always list existing spaces first and reuse one that fits. Create a space only for money shared with other people (household, trip or group), or an explicit request for a separate one. Personal money goes in Personal; never create a space per category, goal, account or month. Ask before creating: creation is a confirmed write, done in Bluu.

contact.description: Someone to add to the user's people.

revoke.description: Revoke an invite link THIS chat made, by the link's `ref` or its space. Its link stops working.

ref.description: The `ref` Bluu gave when this chat made the link.

space.description: The space whose live invite link to revoke. Omit when supplying ref; otherwise ask which space.

space_link.description: A link to join a space, for everyone the user sends it to.

role.description: Invite role. Reusable admin links are refused by Bluu; invite admins individually in the app. Omit for contributor.

space.description: The shared space to invite into. Required; cannot be omitted.

name: invite
title: Invite Someone to Bluu
